originalProcess.shutdown: Closed gracefully after explicit user confirmation that the CDS was idle.

sourceEvidence.installedElectronCommon: Sets DB_DIR only when the process has not already inherited a value; default is PROGRAMDATA\MercantilFiscal\dados.
sourceEvidence.installedBackendDatabase: Uses DB_DIR when present and joins it with mercadao.db.

diagnosticBuild.buildType: Separate unpacked diagnostic package; not installed as an update.
diagnosticBuild.databaseAccess: SQLite OPEN_READONLY; no rows, PRAGMAs, migrations, or application startup modules are invoked.
diagnosticBuild.packageValidation: afterPack verified the isolated entrypoint, shared resolver, evidence helper, package main, and read-only flag.
diagnosticBuild.packageRetention: The temporary package was removed after the successful run; hashes and output origin are recorded here.

officialBuildProcedure.observedBehavior: Runs certification and E2E stages, writes the integrity manifest, removes dist/erp, then invokes electron-builder.
officialBuildProcedure.reason: Avoided deleting or overwriting existing build output; electron-builder used the official ERP configuration copied to a temporary config with an isolated output directory and diagnostic-only entrypoint.

safety.installedApplicationRestartReason: The normal application startup was not relaunched because it may initialize the Destaxa Client, which is outside this step's permitted scope.

coverage: Existing PID evidence is not overwritten
additionalChecks: Isolated electron-builder package completed and afterPack validation passed.

limitations: The runtime SQLite open was performed by the isolated diagnostic PID, not by the original installed PID. Its DB_DIR was copied from the original process environment, and the installed resolver source was independently inspected.
No business records or database schema were queried.
The normal installed CDS process remains closed; restarting it was deliberately avoided to ensure no Destaxa Client initialization.
